title: Coldfog Marches - Ink That Swallows Colour
_note: Drained-zone mood sibling. Less melody, more dread-as-weather - mostly the fog itself. gbc 4-voice band. 66 BPM (intentionally below gbc 80 floor - accept slow-tempo warning), 4/4, suspended A minor, no resolution. 24 bars heavy silence. Vesper motif BARELY A GHOST: only the first interval of the rising leap (E3->A3) surfaces once per loop, unanswered, before the drone reclaims it. lead=one or two faltering pulse25 notes per phrase, more breath than melody. harmony=single sustained pulse12 fog-drone swelling/fading like mist breathing. bass=barely-there pedal tone, sub-felt. drums=a single hollow noise thud at long intervals. Last bar = drone hangs unresolved into the silent top.
